summary: Owner reads are keyed to the authenticated UID and request generation; old-owner results are ignored.
Read state distinguishes loading, refreshing, initial error, ready and stale; successful mutations remain distinguishable from failed readback with Retry.
Focused active owner screens use one 60-second interval, foreground/focus refresh and provider-local-date boundary refresh; timers stop on blur, UID change, disable and background.
Required document rows use canonical per-category requirements and show latest submission separately from a valid approved credential; Approved and Expired are not presented as Live.
Price guidance failure is nonblocking and presents Unavailable with Retry.

selectedCases: ID-LOAD-INITIAL-ERROR distinguishes initial failure from a successful empty result
ID-LOAD-STALE preserves zero-valued data and ID-SAVE-READBACK-ERROR distinguishes failed readback
ID-LOAD-UID-RACE ignores a late response from the previous authenticated UID
coalesces overlapping refreshes into one sequential owner read
disables owner reads and disposes the focused interval when disabled
ID-READINESS-INVALIDATION polls only while focused and active and refreshes on resume and focus
schedules a read at the provider-local date boundary
keeps required credentials scoped to each service category
does not reuse a category-specific legacy document for another category
keeps an approved fallback credential distinct from a newer pending submission
shows a latest replacement submission separately from a still-valid approved credential
uses the server effective expiry status instead of calling an expired credential approved
labels approved credentials Approved, never Live
shows Unavailable with Retry after failure, then remains nonblocking when retried
